citations.claim: EW approach E was green at step 105 then yellow at 106-107 then red at 108, so yellow lasted only 2s vs required 4s
E shows green at step 105 before the truncated yellow
E shows yellow at step 106, start of truncated yellow interval
E still yellow at step 107, end of 2s yellow before red at 108

counterfactual.change: Set actuated false (fixed-time) with all else identical; EW yellow then runs full 4s and no yellow_duration violation occurs.

explanation: Actuated EW green ends early (gap-out) and the controller truncates the following EW yellow to 2s instead of the required yellow_seconds=4s. Steps 105-108 show EW green -> yellow x2 -> red, so yellow lasted 2s. Fixed-time counterfactual removes the early-termination path and passes, confirming actuated yellow truncation as cause.
vision_note: At step 105 the EW approaches show green, then show yellow in steps 106 and 107 before showing red in step 108. The yellow phase is thus visibly present for only two steps instead of the required four seconds.
